hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; if [[ "$f" =~ \.(tsx?|jsx?)$ ]]; then npx prettier --write "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; }
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; if [[ "$f" =~ \.(tsx?|jsx?)$ && ! "$f" =~ node_modules ]]; then npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20 || true; fi; }

jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -qE '^npm run (build|test:e2e)' && (npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -c 'error' || echo '0') | { read errors; if [ "$errors" -gt 0 ]; then echo '{"systemMessage": "⚠️ TypeScript errors detected. Fix before running this command.", "continue": false}'; else echo '{"continue": true}'; fi; } || echo '{"continue": true}'
